clue.text: Power (not clerical) authorised drama

parts.note: P is the standard abbreviation for power in physics
lay describes people who are not clergy
let means allowed or permitted

explanation.surface: A political piece about secular authority being granted, staged as a drama.
explanation.definitionFit: A short theatrical piece is a kind of drama, so the small play fits the wider word.

clue.text: United Nations bread supply becomes visible?

parts.note: rolls are a stock of small loaves of bread

explanation.surface: A UN food delivery arriving in sight of a hungry crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: Something spread out from a scroll is revealed to view, hence the question mark on this loose sense.

clue.text: Race official from South more caustic

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south
tarter means sharper or more acid in tone

explanation.surface: A sharp-tongued official from the southern region at a race meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: The person who fires the gun or drops the flag to begin a race is its official at the start.

clue.text: Bigmouth in Society wearing straw hat

indicators.note: the hat is worn around the society letter, so that letter sits inside it

parts.note: a boater is a flat-topped straw hat

explanation.surface: A loudmouth at a society gathering sporting a straw hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A bigmouth is someone who brags, a synonym for one who talks himself up.

clue.text: Splendour of musical work recalled by politician

indicators.note: recalled is read as called back, so the word for the musical work runs the other way

parts.note: op, short for opus, labels a composer's work
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A politician remembering a grand piece of music.
explanation.definitionFit: Ceremonial display and magnificence are synonyms, as in 'pomp and circumstance'.

clue.text: Is Detective Inspector able to go out with election hopeful?

parts.note: to be able is 'can'
DI is the police abbreviation for detective inspector
to date someone is to go out with them romantically

explanation.surface: Whether a police inspector is allowed to date someone standing for election.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone standing in an election hopes to win, so a hopeful in that contest is a nominee.

clue.text: Euro agent changes for attendants

indicators.note: changes says the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A financial agent dealing in euros switches currencies for the staff.
explanation.definitionFit: A retinue of attendants surrounding an important person is a synonym.

clue.text: Timber agreement

definitions.meaning: pine or fir wood sawn into planks
a bargain or arrangement struck between parties

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both softwood planks and a business bargain, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Hug English doctor before contest

parts.note: MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification
a race is a contest of speed

explanation.surface: An English doctor hugs someone ahead of a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: To hug and to clasp in one's arms are synonyms.

clue.text: Coming together again in French island

definitions.meaning: a gathering of people who meet once more after time apart
an island in the Indian Ocean that is an overseas department of France

explanation.surface: A reunion happening on a French island.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a fresh gathering and the name of France's Indian Ocean island department.

clue.text: Seaman succeeds in attaining objectives

parts.note: tar is old slang for a sailor
to get something is to manage to obtain it

explanation.surface: A sailor manages to achieve his goals.
explanation.definitionFit: Goals one aims at are targets, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Immoderate part of text remembered

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An excessive portion of a memorised passage.
explanation.definitionFit: Going far beyond reasonable limits, so immoderate and excessive are synonyms.

clue.text: Opponents met in revised arrangement — because of this?

definitions.text: Opponents met in revised arrangement — because of this?

indicators.note: a revised arrangement means the letters of the two words are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: Two sides meet on a rearranged date, and the clue asks why.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: a fixture is rescheduled, and the delay is the reason the sides meet on a new date.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting an event off to a later date forces a new fixture, which is the delay the clue describes.

clue.text: Gangster to provide with piece first — he sees danger

parts.note: Al Capone, the Chicago gangster
piece is slang for a gun, so to arm someone is to give them one
1st written with I for 1

explanation.surface: A mobster tooling up first, wary of trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Piece' is gangland slang for a gun.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who raises fears of trouble, often needlessly, is a scaremonger.

clue.text: Liberal dined after expected time

parts.note: ate is the past tense of eat

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician ate his dinner after the scheduled hour.
explanation.definitionFit: Arriving behind schedule is to be tardy, a synonym.

clue.text: Trend initially associated with city's headwear

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the word trend

parts.note: urban means of or relating to a town or city

explanation.surface: A fashion trend linked to city hats.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrapped cloth head covering is an item of headwear, an example of the class.

clue.text: Unusual cave rite showing imagination?

indicators.note: unusual says the letters are put into an unexpected order

explanation.surface: A strange ritual performed in a cave displays inventiveness.
explanation.definitionFit: An inventive, original person displays imagination; the adjective is a synonym.

clue.text: Lustreless rooms

definitions.meaning: dull, without shine, as matt paint
a set of rooms forming one home on a single floor, as British usage has it

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a dull, matt finish and a British apartment, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Close observation almost certain — cover weapon

indicators.note: almost means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: sure means certain
a veil is a covering, especially for the face
a lance is a long spear used by mounted knights

explanation.surface: Being nearly sure that a weapon has been hidden under cover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the last letter of SURE, giving SUR.
explanation.definitionFit: Watching someone closely, as police do a suspect, is monitoring of this kind.

clue.text: One campaigning to reform card user?

indicators.note: to reform means to make again in a new shape, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A campaigner aiming to change the ways of a credit card user.
explanation.definitionFit: A campaigner for a cause is a crusader, a figurative extension of the medieval holy warrior.

clue.text: Desire of Primate to have favourite computers installed

indicators.note: to have here means to hold within, so the primate contains the following pieces
installed means fitted inside, so these pieces go within the primate

parts.note: an ape is a primate
a pet is a favourite, as in teacher's pet
IT, information technology, stands for computers

explanation.surface: An ape longs to have a pet's computers set up.
explanation.definitionFit: A craving or hunger, whether for food or something else, is a synonym for desire.

clue.text: Opposed introduction of arcane poetry

indicators.note: the introduction of a word is its opening letter, here from arcane

parts.note: verse is poetry

explanation.surface: Opposed to opening with obscure poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: Being disinclined or against something is a synonym, as in 'averse to risk'.

clue.text: Pub, European, without elaboration

parts.note: a bar is a pub or drinking place

explanation.surface: A plain, unfussy European pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Facts given plain and unadorned are stark, simple, a synonym.

clue.text: Fitting time for activity by pair?

parts.note: due means proper or fitting, as in 'due respect'

explanation.surface: Asking when the right moment comes for two people to do something together.
explanation.definitionFit: A performance by two musicians or singers is the paired activity meant.
